events.title: ClariTEA: Informal Undergraduate Advising Event
events.summary: Join undergraduate robotics students for ClariTEA, a weekly informal drop-in advising event. Meet with academic advisors, discuss community topics, and enjoy refreshments. This is a great opportunity for students interested in or currently in the robotics program.

evidence.description:
ClariTEA is a weekly informal, drop-in advising event where Robotics and Interested Undergraduate students meet with Robotics Undergraduate Academic Advisors. Refreshments and TEA are offered at each meeting. FRB, RM 2000

Join us in having a conversation with the Robotics Undergraduate community.
